name: Agencia Nacional de Infraestructura
body: Language alternates, a sitemap, alt text on every image, and every internal link opened answered. But the home page loads and configures the same GA4 tag twice, so each visit can be counted as two page views.
lesson: Search the templates for a second gtag snippet. One tag, loaded once, keeps every report honest.
summary: www.ani.gov.co scores 75 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: analytics may count some visits twice.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /inicio, /transparencia-y-acceso-informacion-publica, /servicios-y-tramites and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 20 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
